Shanghai Municipal Council.
July 22nd 1916

POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
The Parliamentarians were entertained to tiffin
and dinner in the Yih Ping Shang—怡香 hotel on
21st inst by the Venus Insurance Company and Nanyang
Bros. Tobacco Coy respectively.
Thirty two M.P.s left for the North at 12 noon.
21st instant by s.s. "Tongshan".
The printing press and furniture of the defunct
Asiatic Daily News have been mortgaged to Arthur & Co
No.20 Nanking Road for $50,000.00.
It is reported that the Koumingtang party is
trying to come to an understanding with the army
and navy here. They intend to hold a conference after
the M.P.s depart for the north.
Sixteen soldiers in uniform left the Arsenal for
Tientsin at 3 p.m. yesterday. It is reported that
they have gone north to recruit some new men.

Your Obedient Servant,

William Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。
1916年7月22日

警务处，
（侦探股）

先生：

本月21日，国会议员分别由维纳斯保险公司（Venus Insurance Company）和南洋兄弟烟草公司（Nanyang Bros. Tobacco Coy）在怡香饭店（Yih Ping Shang—怡香 hotel）招待午宴和晚宴。

三十二名国会议员于本月21日中午12时乘坐“通山”号轮船（s.s. "Tongshan"）启程北上。

已停刊的《亚细亚日报》（Asiatic Daily News）的印刷机和家具已抵押给南京路20号的阿瑟公司（Arthur & Co），抵押金额为50,000.00美元。

据报，国民党正试图与本地的海陆军达成谅解。他们打算在国会议员北上后召开一次会议。

昨日午后3时，十六名身着军装的士兵离开兵工厂前往天津。据报，他们北上是为了招募新兵。

您顺从的仆人，

威廉·阿姆斯特朗
首席侦探督察长

警务处总监
